controls.name: insert-replaces
controls.find: if cell == 0 { St { in0: true, indexed: s.indexed + 1, ..s } } else { St { in1: true, indexed: s.indexed + 1, ..s } }
controls.replace: if cell == 0 { St { in0: true, in1: false, indexed: if found(s) { s.indexed } else { s.indexed + 1 } } } else { St { in1: true, in0: false, indexed: if found(s) { s.indexed } else { s.indexed + 1 } } }
controls.classification: effect: an insert replaces the node's entry wherever it is (the repair)

controls.name: delete-all
controls.find: if s.in0 { (St { in0: false, indexed: s.indexed - 1, ..s }, true) }
controls.replace: if s.in0 { (St { in0: false, in1: false, indexed: s.indexed - entries(s), ..s }, true) }

controls.name: width-checked
controls.find: pub open spec fn search_answers(q: nat, dim: nat) -> bool { true }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn search_answers(q: nat, dim: nat) -> bool { q == dim }
controls.classification: decision: a query of another width is refused (the repair)

controls.name: delete-noop
controls.find: if s.in0 { (St { in0: false, indexed: s.indexed - 1, ..s }, true) }

controls.name: cosine-normalized
controls.find:
entry_score(m, q, v1) > entry_score(m, q, v2)
}
controls.replace:
match m { Metric::Cosine => cosine_above(q, v1, v2), _ => entry_score(m, q, v1) > entry_score(m, q, v2) }
}
controls.classification: decision: under metric cosine Search orders entries by dot/|v| (the repair); theorem_equal_lengths_agree must still verify

controls.name: cosine-takes-l2-branch
controls.find: match m { Metric::Cosine => dot(q, v), Metric::Dot => dot(q, v), Metric::L2 => -sqdist(q, v) }
controls.replace: match m { Metric::Cosine => -sqdist(q, v), Metric::Dot => dot(q, v), Metric::L2 => -sqdist(q, v) }
controls.classification: decision: the cosine branch is not the dot branch (Search's first If chooses another scorer)
